additional_info.subject: ID0405563-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / R6 170002070] LOGO Error CRM:01811000660
additional_info.body:
Dear orel,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Ankita
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002070
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
sPWH2Z
Problem Description
: LOGO Error
Troubleshooting
:  I
t seems that the logo is off because it is not receiving the 24V supply, which is provided by the TB17.
There is an contactor (QA25) between the TB17 and the FC13-FC17 components. Currently, QA25 is tripped, which is why the components are not getting the required 24V supply and TB18 is also not receiving the input. Please refer to the attached image for more details on the issue.
There is a possibility that QA25 is faulty, so please ensure you carry a spare with you. While there are fewer chances of a fault with TB18, it would be advisable to carry a spare of that as well, which you can use if needed in the future.
Also, I want to confirm that there is no possibility of a faulty TB17, as you can see from the attached images, FC12 is on and receiving 24V from TB17, which shows that the 24V supply from TB17 is working fine.
MLFB No.
3RT2016-2BB41 -QA25
6EP3322-6SB00-0AY0 -TB18
For future reference, your case number is
0405563
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
If you need any help during the site intervention, please let us know in advance so that we can provide support.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare

additional_info.subject: Note to L2
additional_info.body:
There was an issue with a broken KF10 logo, which was replaced by the RC. However, after the replacement, the charger is still not functioning. The RC has created a ticket for further investigation.
Based on the circuit,  seems like an issue with the QA25 coil. After reviewing images of the charger, it was observed that TB18 was off, while TB17 and FC12 were on. FC11 to FC17 were off.
The RC checked the 24V supply to the logo and verified continuity.
The RC replaced the QA25 coil, but the charger is still not working.
The RC will be on-site around 9 AM Israel time (1 PM IST). Samabth will be present for assistance if needed.
Please contact with Orel, He will be on site tomorrow around 1PM (IST).
